name: What kind of drainage is required for a curbless shower?

mainEntity.name: What kind of drainage is required for a curbless shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: A curbless shower requires careful planning for effective drainage to prevent water from escaping the shower area. This typically involves sloping the shower floor towards a linear drain or a center drain at a specific gradient. The subfloor underneath must be properly prepared and waterproofed, creating a continuous waterproof membrane that extends up the walls. In some cases, a 'zero-threshold' design might still incorporate a subtle, barely visible slope or a slight recess to ensure all water flows directly to the drain.
acceptedAnswer.description: Curbless showers require a sloped floor and robust waterproofing towards a linear or center drain to ensure proper water containment and prevent leaks.
